The passages from Rank 1 and Rank 5 collectively cover all essential aspects requested by the question.","supported_requirements":[{"requirement":"Airbnb generates revenue from service fees and host fees related to stays and experiences.","passage_rank":1,"quote":"Revenue Our revenue consists of service fees, net of incentives and refunds, charged to our customers. We consider both hosts and guests to be our customers. For stays, service fees, which are charged to customers as a percentage of the value of the booking, excluding taxes, vary based on factors specific to the booking, such as booking value, the duration of the booking, geography, and host type.
